motion.name: button-state
motion.purpose: Hover transition; removed by prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

components.name: Outlined action
components.description: Sidebar action or starter prompt. Runtime supplies control padding.
components.css: .ds-action { font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid #ccd5ce; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--chat-ink, #202523); background: #ffffff; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-action:hover { background: #eaf1ec; border-color: #8fae9c; color: #184a35; } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--chat-accent, #24624b); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-action:disabled { color: #727b76; background: #eff2ef; border-color: var(--chat-line, #e2e7e3); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-action { transition: none; } }

components.name: Composer surface
components.description: Native textarea preview of the composer surface. Streamlit supplies the runtime submit control.
components.css: .ds-composer { border: 1px solid #bccbc0; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(26, 45, 34, .06); } .ds-composer:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--chat-accent, #24624b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-composer-text { font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--chat-ink, #202523); caret-color: var(--chat-accent, #24624b); background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 16px; } .ds-composer-text::placeholder { color: var(--chat-muted, #59645e); opacity: 1; }

components.name: User message
components.description: Right-aligned tinted bubble with a visible speaker label.
components.html:
You
What is the status of my transfer?
components.css: .ds-user { font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--chat-ink, #202523); margin-left: auto; max-width: 85%; background: #edf3ee; border-radius: 16px; padding: 1rem 1.2rem; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-user-caption { font-size: .75rem; color: var(--chat-muted, #59645e); line-height: 1.5; opacity: 1; }

components.name: Assistant text surface
components.description: Open transcript body and caption. Runtime also supplies the support-agent avatar.
components.html:
FablePay assistant

Ask about a payment, track a transfer, or get help with your card.
components.css: .ds-assistant { font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--chat-ink, #202523); max-width: 75ch; line-height: 1.65; padding: 1rem 0; background: transparent; } .ds-assistant-caption { color: var(--chat-muted, #59645e); font-size: .75rem; line-height: 1.5; opacity: 1; }

components.name: Support heading
components.description: Compact transcript title and demo metadata.
components.html:
Support assistant

AI · FablePay demo
components.css: .ds-heading { font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--chat-ink, #202523); display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding-bottom: 1.2rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--chat-line, #e2e7e3); } .ds-heading-title { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 0; margin: 0; } .ds-heading-meta { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--chat-muted, #59645e); } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-heading { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; gap: .25rem; } }

narrative.overview:
This describes the shipped interface rather than proposing a new brand identity. FablePay is a fictional finance support demo with one active conversation. A white transcript, pale sidebar, restrained green accent, and compact support header keep the question and answer central.

Useful task prompts introduce the empty state. Sources, record details, review details, and diagnostics are progressively disclosed. Demo ownership and account limitations remain visible in the sidebar. This documentation records the existing presentation; it does not change backend or API semantics.
keyCharacteristics: One active conversation with a bottom composer.
Quiet neutral surfaces and dark readable text.
Three task prompts before the first exchange.
Collapsed supporting details and sidebar diagnostics.
dos: **Do** keep one active transcript and a bottom composer.
**Do** preserve full-opacity captions and the 75ch assistant maximum.
**Do** keep evidence and diagnostics available through collapsed details.
**Do** retain visible fictional-demo context and account limitations.
**Do** preserve keyboard focus, disabled states, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: **Don't** introduce multiple-conversation navigation into this experience.
**Don't** expand raw records or technical diagnostics into the default answer view.
**Don't** imply that local review requests contact a real bank.
